info.name: Hipay Payment Gateway balance settlement API
Lists settlements for your merchant account

params.name: amount
params.description: Parameter which filters settlements equal to this amount.

params.name: currency
params.description: Parameter which filters settlements in this currency. This three-character currency code complies with ISO 4217.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Parameter which filters settlements after this date (format YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: date_to
params.description: Parameter which filters settlements before this date (format YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: sort
params.description: Parameter which sorts settlements by this parameter.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of settlements to be returned.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows you to get the whole list of settlements for the merchant account you're authenticated with.
The results are paginated, which means that not all the settlements are returned in one API call. Check the `page` and `per_page` parameters for more information about pagination.

You may need to search for particular settlements. To this end, this endpoint also offers filtering parameters which allow you to get settlements for a specific amount and currency or in a specific date ra

info.name: Retrieves details on a specific settlement

items.docs:
This endpoint allows you to get all details for a specific settlement based on its settlement ID. Details include:

- Bank transfer info (bank name, recipient IBAN, etc.)

- Total amount transferred to the bank account

- Detailed amounts (sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees, etc.)

info.name: Returns the content of a settlement file in a given format

params.name: ext
params.description: The format of the settlement raw file you want to download.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows you to download a settlement file in raw format given a specific settlement ID.
Available formats for download are: `.txt`, `.xls` and `.csv`.
